description: Updates an existing Trello checklist, allowing modification of its name, position, associated card/board, or copying items from a source checklist.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board to which the checklist should be moved or associated.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idCard.description: The ID of the Trello card to which the checklist should be moved or associated.
idCard.title: Id Card

idChecklist.description: The unique identifier of the Trello checklist to be updated.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idChecklistSource.description: The ID of a source Trello checklist whose items should be copied into the checklist being updated.
idChecklistSource.title: Id Checklist Source

name.description: The new name for the checklist. Must be a string with a length between 0 and 16384 characters, inclusive.
name.title: Name

pos.description: The new position for the checklist on the card. Accepts 'top', 'bottom', or a string representing a positive number (e.g., '1', '1024', '1.5').
pos.title: Pos

name: update_checklists_by_id_checklist

CheckItem.description: Represents a check item within a checklist.

due.description: Due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ).
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: Number of minutes before the due date when a reminder should be sent.
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: Unique identifier of the check item.
id.title: Id

idMember.description: ID of the member assigned to the check item.
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: Name or description of the check item.
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional name data for the check item.
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: Position of the check item within the checklist.
pos.title: Pos

state.description: Completion state of the check item (e.g., 'complete' or 'incomplete').
state.title: State

CheckItem.title: CheckItem

checkItems.description: Array of check items within the checklist.
checkItems.title: Check Items

idBoard.description: ID of the board the checklist belongs to.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idCard.description: ID of the card the checklist is attached to.
idCard.title: Id Card

pos.description: Position of the checklist on the card.
pos.title: Pos
